claude.result:
`subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` now works. The full suite passes with the new tests (35 tests), and I ran the CLI by hand once.

The hand run used a plan starting 2026-10-20. It showed €259.57 a month, and `renewals` listed it for 27 Oct.

- **Weekly plans:**
  - `--every week` and `--every weekly` are accepted, and the usage text and README mention them.
  - The monthly cost is price × 52 ÷ 12 (€12 a week gives €52.00).
  - Charges fall every 7 days from `--since`.
- **Rounding:** monthly costs round to the nearest cent, so the €119.99 yearly plan now shows €10.00. A €14.50 yearly plan now shows €1.21 instead of €1.20.
- **CSV export:** it had its own copy of the monthly cost calculation, still cutting off at the cent. It now uses the same function as everything else, so `list`, `total`, `add` and `export` all agree.

I also fixed two things you didn't ask for:
- **Loading saved files:** the loader turned any cycle other than yearly into monthly. A saved weekly plan would have silently become monthly the next time the file was read. Now only the old 0.1 names (`month`, `year`) are converted.
- **Renewals order:** `renewals` sorted by the text label ("27 Oct"), not by date, so a "1 Dec" charge would have sorted before "2 Nov". With 7-day charges this would show up more often, so it now sorts by date.

My first attempt to run the edits as a shell script was blocked, so I redid them with the file-edit tool. Nothing is committed.
